Default y-axis label implied by the plotted series' transforms

default_y_axis.Rd

Same rule as prep_chart: "%" when every series has a growth transform; "Index (<base> = 100)" / "Indeks (...)" when every series is indexed to the same base; otherwise NULL. Pass the plotted rows' columns.

Usage

default_y_axis(growth, index, language = "si")

Arguments

growth, index

character vectors, one element per plotted series

language

"si" or "en"

Value

character scalar or NULL
